dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses extensive COPY statements with INC copybooks, no EXEC SQL/CICS, fixed format.
evidence: no EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt/billing system - hospitalization billing confirmation screen (入院請求確認画面). Handles inpatient admission/discharge billing, insurance combination, payment collection records.
purpose.summary: This program (ORCGI04) is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It implements an inpatient billing confirmation screen, managing hospitalization records, insurance combinations, payment collection, and billing calculations. It interacts with numerous master files and history records related to patient admission, medical acts, and billing.

notable_features: Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS)
OCCURS tables for billing periods and payment records
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Extensive flag and index working storage areas
verdict.notes: Source file is 7231 lines, heavily commented in Japanese (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1 causing mojibake in display). The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical billing system used widely in Japanese medical institutions. program_type set to online-cics as a proxy for interactive screen program, though ORCA uses its own screen framework (not CICS).
